nodes.label: Motion Effects Recipes
nodes.rationale: Contains the detailed specifications (start, end, timing, premium details) for each of the 16 effects.

nodes.label: 16 Effects Build Recipes
nodes.rationale: The core system defining 16 motion effect recipes running on an 8-second clock.

nodes.label: 8-Second Clock
nodes.rationale: Standardized timing loop for all effects: Start (0.0), Move (0.0-2.2), Hold (2.2-6.6), Return (6.6-8.0), Loop (8.0).

nodes.label: MOTION.md
nodes.rationale: Referenced source for color roles: ground, surface, ink, muted, accent, and second accent.

nodes.label: 01 Button → Player
nodes.rationale: Interface effect where a pill button stretches into a full video player.

nodes.label: 02 Search → Results
nodes.rationale: Interface effect showing a search box opening, typing, and results stacking.

nodes.label: 03 Card → Workspace
nodes.rationale: Interface effect where a small card grows into a full editor window.

nodes.label: 04 Tabs → Panels
nodes.rationale: Interface effect featuring a sliding selection pill with stretch/squash physics.

nodes.label: 05 Chart Morph
nodes.rationale: Data effect where bar charts morph into a line chart through shared values.

nodes.label: 06 Dashboard Zoom
nodes.rationale: Data effect where a KPI tile lifts out of a dashboard using corner brackets and dashed guides.

nodes.label: 07 Spring Stack
nodes.rationale: Data effect using spring physics and damping to fan out a stack of cards.

nodes.label: 08 Magnetic Dock
nodes.rationale: Data effect where icons swell based on cursor distance using a bell curve.

nodes.label: 09 Masked Type
nodes.rationale: Type effect where artwork rises through letterforms using a mask.

nodes.label: 10 Elastic Type
nodes.rationale: Type effect where letters stretch on a locked baseline with width/height compensation.

nodes.label: 11 Text → Layout
nodes.rationale: Type effect where a headline reflows into a full article page layout.

nodes.label: 12 Image Reveal
nodes.rationale: Type/Visual effect using sequential shutter slats to reveal an image.

nodes.label: 13 Perspective Shift
nodes.rationale: System effect pulling flat layers apart into 3D space with a shared vanishing point.

nodes.label: 14 Glass Focus
nodes.rationale: System effect using a magnifying lens with chromatic aberration and blur.

nodes.label: 15 Flowing Paths
nodes.rationale: System effect showing pulses of light traveling through nodes and connectors.

nodes.label: 16 Particle Logo
nodes.rationale: System effect where scattered dots fly on arcs to assemble a logo mark.
